'''''UFC Fight Night: Cortes-Acosta vs. Walker''''' (also known as '''''UFC Fight Night 293''''' and '''''UFC Vegas 124''''') is an upcoming [[mixed martial arts]] event produced by the [[Ultimate Fighting Championship]] that is scheduled to take place on November 7, 2026, at the [[UFC Apex|Meta Apex]] in [[Enterprise, Nevada]], part of the [[Las Vegas Valley]], United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/story/sports/ufc/2026/08/26/ufc-meta-apex-event-approvals/91468590007/|title=UFC officially adds four more Meta APEX events to 2026 schedule|publisher=mmajunkie.usatoday.com|author=Nolan King|date=2026-08-26|access-date=2026-08-26}}</ref>

==Background==
A welterweight bout between former [[Legacy Fighting Alliance#LFA Welterweight Championship|LFA Welterweight Champion]] [[Gabriel Bonfim]] and [[Sean Brady (fighter)|Sean Brady]] was scheduled to headline the event.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.thescore.com/mma/news/3580479/brady-bonfim-to-headline-nov-7-ufc-event|title=Brady-Bonfim to headline Nov. 7 UFC event|publisher=thescore.com|author=Nick Baldwin|date=2026-08-16|access-date=2026-08-16}}</ref> However, on October 29, Brady withdrew due to a staph infection in his knee, resulting in the cancellation of the bout.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mmafighting.com/ufc/518348/sean-brady-out-of-ufc-vegas-124-main-event-against-gabriel-bonfim|title=Sean Brady out of UFC Vegas 124 main event against Gabriel Bonfim|publisher=mmafighting.com|author=Damon Martin|date=2026-10-29|access-date=2026-10-29}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://bloodyelbow.com/2026/10/29/sean-brady-explains-why-he-withdrew-from-gabriel-bonfim-main-event-i-couldnt-walk/|title=Sean Brady explains why he withdrew from Gabriel Bonfim main event on short notice: 'I couldn't walk'|publisher=bloodyelbow.com|author=Kyle Dimond|date=2026-10-29|access-date=2026-10-30}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/story/sports/ufc/2026/10/29/gabriel-bonfim-reacts-ufc-vegas-124-main-event-cancellation/92505708007/|title=Gabriel Bonfim reacts to UFC Vegas 124 main event cancellation|publisher=mmajunkie.usatoday.com|author=Nolan King|date=2026-10-29|access-date=2026-10-30}}</ref> In turn, a non-scheduled heavyweight bout between former [[Legacy Fighting Alliance#LFA Heavyweight Championship|LFA Heavyweight Champion]] [[Waldo Cortes-Acosta]] and [[Johnny Walker (fighter)|Johnny Walker]] was subsequently booked as the event's new headliner.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mmamania.com/ufc-fight-announcements/482485/waldo-cortes-acosta-vs-johnny-walker-now-headlines-ufc-vegas-124|title=Report: Waldo Cortes-Acosta vs Johnny Walker now headlines UFC Vegas 124|publisher=mmamania.com|author=Alexander Behunin|date=2026-10-29|access-date=2026-10-30}}</ref>

A women's strawweight bout between former [[UFC Women's Strawweight Championship]] challenger (also [[The Ultimate Fighter: Team Joanna vs. Team Cláudia]] strawweight winner) [[Tatiana Suarez]] and former [[Invicta Fighting Championships#Strawweight Championship|Invicta FC Strawweight Champion]] (also former fellow strawweight title challenger) [[Virna Jandiroba]] is scheduled for this event.<ref name="bouts">{{Cite web|url=https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/story/sports/ufc/2026/09/11/virna-jandiroba-vs-tatiana-suarez-booked-again-for-ufc-vegas-124/91713281007/|title=Virna Jandiroba vs. Tatiana Suarez booked (again) for UFC Vegas 124|publisher=mmajunkie.usatoday.com|author=Mike Bohn|date=2026-09-11|access-date=2026-09-12}}</ref> They were originally scheduled to compete at [[UFC on ESPN: Sandhagen vs. Font]] in August 2023, but Jandiroba had to withdraw due to a knee injury.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mmamania.com/2023/5/18/23729392/tatiana-suarez-draws-virna-jandiroba-for-strawweight-return-in-august-ufc|title=Tatiana Suarez draws Virna Jandiroba for strawweight return in August|publisher=mmamania.com|author=Drake Riggs|date=2023-05-18|access-date=2026-09-11}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/2023/06/ufc-news-tatiana-suarez-vs-jessica-andrade-aug-5-fight-night-nashville-virna-jandiroba-injury|title=Virna Jandiroba injured; Tatiana Suarez to face former UFC champ Jessica Andrade in Nashville|publisher=mmajunkie.usatoday.com|author=Matthew Wells and Nolan King|date=2023-06-20|access-date=2023-09-11}}</ref> They were later scheduled to compete at [[UFC 310]] in December 2024, but Suarez had to withdraw due to an unspecified health issue.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mmafighting.com/2024/9/17/24247696/tatiana-suarez-vs-virna-jandiroba-set-for-ufc-310-in-december|title=Tatiana Suarez vs. Virna Jandiroba set for UFC 310 in December|publisher=mmafighting.com|author=Jed Meshew|date=2024-09-17|access-date=2026-09-11}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mmafighting.com/2024/10/21/24276317/tatiana-suarez-out-of-ufc-310-fight-against-virna-jandiroba|title=Tatiana Suarez out of UFC 310 fight against Virna Jandiroba|publisher=mmafighting.com|author=Damon Martin|date=2024-10-21|access-date=2026-09-11}}</ref>

A heavyweight bout between Alvin Hines and promotional newcomer Gabriel Lorenço was scheduled for this event.<ref name="bouts"/> However, Hines was forced to pull out from the bout due to vertigo and was replaced by former LFA heavyweight champion Thomas Petersen.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sherdog.com/news/news/Vertigo-delays-Alvin-Hines-pursuit-of-first-UFC-victory-203121|title=Vertigo delays Alvin Hines' pursuit of first UFC victory|publisher=sherdog.com|author=Sayan Nag|date=2026-10-08|access-date=2026-10-08}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.si.com/fannation/mma/news/first-ufc-fight-night-event-of-november-hit-with-late-change|title=First UFC Fight Night Event of November Hit With Late Change|publisher=si.com|author=Drew Beaupre|date=2026-10-26|access-date=2026-10-26}}</ref>

Mantas Kondratavičius and Wesley Schultz were scheduled to meet in a middleweight bout.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ufc.com/news/tickets-sale-october-10-october-31-and-november-7-ufc-fight-night-events-meta-apex|title=Tickets On Sale For UFC Fight Night Events At Meta APEX|publisher=ufc.com|author=Staff|date=2026-09-29|access-date=2026-10-26}}</ref> However, Schultz pulled out from the event and was replaced by [[Andre Petroski]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://bloodyelbow.com/2026/10/25/ufc-vegas-123-takes-a-hit-as-fighter-withdraws-after-passing-out-at-cvs/|title=UFC Vegas 123 takes a hit as fighter withdraws after passing out at CVS|publisher=bloodyelbow.com|author=Jordan Ellis|date=2026-10-25|access-date=2026-10-26}}</ref>

A featherweight bout between Austin Bashi and [[Lucas Brennan]] was scheduled for the event.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/story/sports/ufc/2026/09/11/ufc-news-austin-bashi-vs-lucas-brennan/91715588007/|title=Rising UFC featherweights scheduled for November clash|publisher=mmajunkie.usatoday.com|author=Nolan King|date=2026-09-11|access-date=2026-10-29}}</ref> However, Brennan had to withdraw due to a full-thickness tear of his [[anterior cruciate ligament|ACL]] and was replaced by promotional newcomer Carlos Calderon on four days' notice.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/story/sports/ufc/2026/10/29/ufc-vegas-124-lucas-brennan-out-vs-austin-bashi/92503544007/|title=Full thickness tear of ACL forces UFC Vegas 124 featherweight out of bout|publisher=mmajunkie.usatoday.com|author=Nolan King|date=2026-10-29|access-date=2026-10-30}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mmamania.com/ufc-fight-announcements/484031/ufc-newcomer-steps-up-on-four-days-notice-for-ufc-vegas-124|title=UFC newcomer steps up on four days’ notice for UFC Vegas 124|publisher=mmamania.com|author=Alexander Behunin|date=2026-11-04|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
